title: Director of Quality Assurance
text:
About the job

**JOB TITLE:**
Director of Quality Assurance

**REPORTS TO:**
Senior VP of Operations

**DEPARTMENT:**
Operations

**LOCATION:**
Columbus, OH

**WAGE:**
Salaried, Exempt

**WORK HOURS:**
Full-time, Variable

**TRAVEL:**
Frequent, 40–60%

**Job Summary**

The Director of Quality Assurance is responsible for providing strategic leadership and direction for all quality assurance, quality control, and quality systems functions across Plaskolite’s global operations. This role ensures the company’s products consistently meet or exceed internal standards, customer expectations and applicable regulatory requirements.

The Director of QA oversees the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Plaskolite’s Quality Management System (QMS) to drive standardization, process capability, and operational excellence. This position works closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to strengthen quality performance, enhance customer satisfaction, and promote a proactive culture of quality — aligned with the
**“One Plaskolite”**
vision of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

This position requires diligence, the ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, and a strong commitment to safety, teamwork, and quality—reflecting Plaskolite’s core values of
**Integrity and Improvement.**

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all quality assurance and control activities across Plaskolite’s manufacturing sites and business units.
* Develop and implement the company’s Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with ISO, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead and mentor Quality Managers, Supervisors, and Engineers, building a high-performing team that supports operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Facilitate the publishing and communication of company-wide quality objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs), and metrics to measure and improve performance based on the input of Process Owners.
* Drive standardization of quality systems, processes, and documentation across all facilities to ensure consistency and compliance.
* Serve as the company’s primary liaison with major customers regarding quality performance, audits, and improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with Sales, Customer Service and MFG sites, to address customer-specific quality requirements, audits, and documentation needs.
* Coordinate with manufacturing sites, the resolution of critical quality issues and customer complaints through data-driven root cause analysis (RCA) and effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Partner with Supply Chain and Procurement teams to ensure suppliers meet Plaskolite’s standards for quality, delivery, and reliability.
* Partner with Product Development and Engineering to integrate quality and reliability requirements into new products, material and manufacturing processes.
* Lead quality review meetings, providing executive-level insights on performance, risk, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Support Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and statistical process control (SPC) methodologies to improve process efficiency and product quality.
* Evaluate and recommend innovative technologies, testing methods, and data analytics tools to enhance quality monitoring and reporting capabilities.
* Manage Corporate Quality budget, staffing, and resource allocation to ensure effective support for operational and strategic objectives.
* Represent the Quality function in cross-functional executive meetings, business reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
* Ensure that all quality functions and personnel adhere to company safety policies, environmental regulations, and ethical business practices.
* Build and maintain a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence within the Quality organization.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Operation, or Manufacturing Management, Chemistry, Polymer Science or related technical fields.
* 10–15+ years in quality, manufacturing, or operational excellence roles.
* 5–8+ years managing teams and managers

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Professional Certifications (highly valued, not required):
* ASQ Certified Quality Manager (CQM/OE)
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE)
* Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt
* ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 / ISO 14001 Lead Auditor
* Lean Manufacturing certifications
* Strategic quality planning and deployment
* Risk management and failure mode analysis (FMEA)
* Customer-facing leadership during escalations
* Change management and culture transformation
* Data-driven decision-making
* Effective communication with executives and external stakeholders

**AVAILABLE BENEFITS:**

* Sign-On Bonus
* Health Insurance 401(k) and Employer Contribution
* Paid time off
* Paid Holidays
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Life Insurance
* Employee discount program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Voluntary Life Insurance

**About Plaskolite**

PLASKOLITE is a global leader in manufacturing of engineering thermoplastics, including Acrylic, Polycarbonate, ABS, Olefin and PETG Sheet, Extruded Profiles and PMMA Polymers. Founded in 1950, by Donald Dunn and family, PLASKOLITE has a reputation for providing the highest quality products in the industry. Our innovative thermoplastic solutions are used in a wide variety of applications, including glazing, safety shields, lighting, signs and point-of-purchase displays. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, with manufacturing facilities throughout North America and Europe, Plaskolite delivers superior thermoplastic sheet, profiles, and polymers to the world thru long-lasting customer relationships and hands-on customer service.

***PLASKOLITE is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. If requested, the Company will provide reasonable accommodation to otherwise qualified individuals where appropriate to allow the ++individual to perform the essential functions of the job, so long as doing so does not create an undue hardship on the business.***

**Additional Job Application Terms**

This job is part of LinkedIn’s Full-Service Hiring beta program. Eligibility is limited to candidates located in and performing services in the United States, excluding those based in Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, South Carolina, or West Virginia.

We’re committed to making our hiring process as smooth and timely as possible, and we understand that waiting to hear back can add to the anticipation. If you’re a potential fit, our team will reach out within two weeks to progress you to the next stage. If you don’t hear from us in that time, we encourage you to explore other opportunities with our team in the future, and we wish you the very best in your job search.
